description: User input schema for AIFA style consultation. Single source of truth — scoring engine, prompt, and frontend all reference this file.

build.label: Body Build
build.help: Your overall frame and mass. Slim = lean/narrow. Heavy = prominent midsection.

face_shape.label: Face Shape
face_shape.help: Look in a mirror. Is your face wider than long? Narrow? Round? Small-featured?

neck.label: Neck Type
neck.help: Short = collars feel crowded. Long = lots of space between chin and chest. Thick = wide, often with athletic build.

skin_undertone.label: Skin Undertone
skin_undertone.help: Check your wrist veins: green = warm, blue/purple = cool. Gold jewelry suits you = warm. Silver = cool. Both = neutral.

body_shape.label: Body Shape
body_shape.help: Trapezoid = proportional. Inverted triangle = broad shoulders, narrow waist. Rectangle = straight up-and-down. Oval = round midsection.

skin_depth.label: Skin Depth
skin_depth.help: How light or dark your overall skin tone is, regardless of undertone.

overall_contrast.label: Feature Contrast
overall_contrast.help: How much difference between your skin, hair, and eye color. Dark hair + light skin = high. Similar tones all over = low.

facial_hair.label: Facial Hair
facial_hair.help: Your typical facial hair style. This affects neckline and collar recommendations.

hair_style.label: Hair Style
hair_style.help: Your typical hairstyle. Affects overall head proportion and hat recommendations.

glasses_style.label: Glasses
glasses_style.help: If you wear glasses daily, what frame style? This affects neckline framing.

torso_vs_leg_ratio.label: Torso-Leg Ratio
torso_vs_leg_ratio.help: Are your legs short relative to your torso, or vice versa? Affects trouser rise recommendations.

waist_definition.label: Waist Definition
waist_definition.help: How defined is your waist? Defined = clear taper. Prominent = midsection is widest point.

head_size.label: Head Size
head_size.help: Relative to your shoulders. Small head + wide shoulders looks different from large head + narrow shoulders.

style_track.label: Style Preference
style_track.help: Casual = tees, jeans, sneakers. Smart casual = polos, chinos, loafers.
